title: MyRecon Basic: USD 3.99 Monthly or USD 19.99 Yearly
description: Basic: USD 3.99/month, USD 19.99/year, or INR 299/month with Razorpay. A 3-day free trial on both plans. Cancel automatic renewal anytime.
h1: One Basic plan, monthly or yearly
intro: Free accounts get 5 standard scans per UTC day. Basic costs US$3.99/month or US$19.99/year through PayPal, or ₹299/month through Razorpay. New subscribers get a 3-day free trial with 3 Extended scans. Paid monthly periods include 10 Extended scans; paid yearly periods include 120. Basic includes unlimited standard scans and Deep Search while active. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first subscription charge. Buy Me a Coffee remains US$3.99 one-time for 10 non-expiring Extended credits, unlimited standard scans and Deep Search.

sections.heading: Match scan scope to your task
sections.body: Match the plan to the task you actually have. For a one-off public username self-audit, begin with the available scanner and review its current scope; choose a larger or account-based option only when its documented limits meet your needs.

sections.heading: Confirm current terms before choosing
sections.body: Do not rely on an old screenshot or copied plan description. Check the current product notice, record the date if you are comparing plans, and contact MyRecon through its current support route when a term is unclear.

faq.question: Does a missing username result prove no account exists?
faq.answer: No. A site may block, rate-limit, rename, or restrict a profile, and some services may not be supported. Treat an unavailable or missing result as inconclusive unless the source provides a verifiable reason.

faq.question: Can MyRecon see private accounts?
faq.answer: No. Public username checks do not grant access to private accounts or restricted content. Use service-approved access and consent, and do not bypass login walls or platform controls to complete a search.
